About Our Church

A family of believers rooted in faith

Nyaura SDA Church is a vibrant Seventh-day Adventist congregation committed to worshiping God in spirit and truth. For over 25 years, we've been a beacon of hope in our community.

We believe in the transformative power of faith, the importance of community, and the hope found in God's Word. Our doors are open to all who seek spiritual growth and meaningful fellowship.

What We Believe

28 Fundamental Beliefs

As Seventh-day Adventists, our faith is grounded in Scripture and centered on the hope of Christ's return. Explore the core beliefs that guide our walk with God.

№ 1

Holy Scripture

The Bible is the inspired Word of God — our rule of faith and practice.

№ 2

The Trinity

One God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, co-eternal and co-equal.

№ 3

The Father

God the Father is the Creator, sustainer, and sovereign Lord of all.

№ 4

The Son

Jesus Christ is God incarnate, our Saviour, High Priest, and coming King.

№ 5

The Holy Spirit

The Spirit inspires, empowers, and transforms believers into Christlikeness.

№ 6

Creation

God created the world in six literal days and rested on the seventh.

№ 7

The Sabbath

The seventh day (Saturday) is the Sabbath of the Lord, a day of rest and worship.

№ 8

Marriage & Family

Marriage was established by God at Creation as a lifelong union of man and woman.

№ 9

Life, Death & Resurrection

Christ took on human nature, lived a sinless life, died for our sins, and rose again.

№ 10

The Great Controversy

All humanity is involved in the great cosmic conflict between Christ and Satan.

№ 11

The Experience of Salvation

By grace alone, through faith in Christ, we are justified and sanctified.

№ 12

Growing in Christ

Through the Spirit, we grow in grace, prayer, Bible study, and witness.

№ 13

The Church

The church is the community of believers who confess Jesus Christ as Lord.

№ 14

Baptism & Communion

Baptism by immersion and the Lord's Supper are ordinances of the church.

№ 15

Spiritual Gifts

The Holy Spirit gives spiritual gifts to empower ministry and witness.

№ 16

The Gift of Prophecy

Scripture identifies the gift of prophecy as a sign of the remnant church.

№ 17

The Law of God

The Ten Commandments reveal God's will and remain binding on all believers.

№ 18

The Sabbath Rest

The seventh-day Sabbath is a sign of creation, redemption, and sanctification.

№ 19

Stewardship

We are God's stewards of time, talents, possessions, and the gospel.

№ 20

Christian Behavior

We are called to live holy lives, reflecting Christ in all we do.

№ 21

Marriage & the Family

The family is the central institution of human society, established by God.

№ 22

Christian Unity

The church is one body with many members, called to unity in Christ.

№ 23

The Remnant & Mission

A faithful remnant proclaims the three angels' messages of Revelation 14.

№ 24

The Second Coming

Christ's personal, visible return is the blessed hope of the church.

№ 25

Death & Resurrection

The dead sleep in the grave until the resurrection at Christ's return.

№ 26

The Millennium & End of Sin

Christ reigns with the redeemed for a thousand years; then sin is finally destroyed.

№ 27

The New Earth

God will create a new heaven and new earth where righteousness dwells.

№ 28

Heaven

Heaven is the home of the redeemed, where we will dwell with God forever.

Our Leadership

Pr. Daniel Mwangi

Senior Pastor

With a heart for ministry and a passion for sharing the Gospel, Pastor Daniel Mwangi leads our congregation with wisdom, compassion, and a genuine love for God's people.

Trained at Bugema University and ordained in 2010, Pastor Mwangi has faithfully served churches across East Africa before joining Nyaura in 2021. He and his wife Grace have three children.

"Come as you are. God has a plan for your life, and it starts with you taking the first step through those doors."

📧 pastor@nyaurachurch.org
